title: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
abstract: arXiv:2611.09634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model. One preference vector selects the adapter mixture that generates responses and weights the separately normalized rewards used to update the adapters. A single training run supports changing preferences at inference without further optimization. We experiment with four models on helpfulness and harmlessness and on solving math problems while following instructions. translated_title: 基于联合训练低秩适配器的可引导多目标组相对偏好优化
translated_abstract: 语言模型的部署通常需要在不同竞争目标之间进行不同的权衡，且这种权衡会随着用户偏好的变化而改变，然而标准的后训练方法通常只能产生针对固定目标权重的单一策略。我们提出了LambdaMix，这是一种新的参数高效方法，通过组相对在线强化学习来学习一个以偏好为条件的策略族。LambdaMix在冻结的基础模型上为每个目标联合训练一个低秩适配器。一个偏好向量选择生成响应的适配器混合方式，并对用于更新适配器的、分别归一化的奖励进行加权。单次训练即可支持在推理时改变偏好而无需进一步的优化。我们在四个模型上进行了实验，涵盖有用性与无害性，以及在遵循指令的同时解决数学问题。我们还对两个最大的模型进行了评估，测试其在改写评论时既能保留措辞又能减少关于个人……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LambdaMix，一种参数高效方法，在冻结基础模型上为每个目标联合训练一个低秩适配器并结合组相对在线强化学习，只需单次训练即可在推理时根据偏好向量灵活调整多目标间的权衡，无需额外优化。
en_tdlr: LambdaMix, a parameter-efficient method that jointly trains one low-rank adapter per objective over a frozen base model with group-relative online RL, enabling a single training run to steer multi-objective trade-offs at inference time via a preference vector without further optimization.
